description: EVM-007 AC1, AC3 (ADR-0018 V4; plan P4, architect 3): the fixed list of infrastructure images of the VM, by tag + digest. Installed only in an IaC session (compose.infra.yaml); scanned with the release images in the publish job (bramka 6). Every digest is the multi-arch index (not a single-platform manifest) and the index contains the platform below (the Arm64 VM, Hetzner CAX; checked against the registry 2026-10-21): clamav/clamav (Alpine) is amd64-only, so ClamAV comes from clamav/clamav-debian (amd64, arm64, ppc64le). EVM-124: `builtImages` are the images built by the project in CI (publish-infra, natively for linux/arm64) and published to private GHCR packages; they have NO digest here - it comes from the CI record `infra-images-record` and the attestation of provenance, verified in the IaC session (docs/ops/runbooks/media-processor.md), so they are not in `images` and are not pulled in publish.
